l.i: Series eorum, qui muneribus toti provincia communibus praefuerunt ab anno M. D.XCIIII, quo civitas cum agro vicino foederi Ordinum Belgicorum est restituta: Et primum quidem istorum, qui in collegijs sunt huius orae & provinciae propriis: deinde illorum, qui in collegijs communibus, atque extra hanc provinciam sedes habentibus.

main_text.l: In collegio deputatorum, cujus caput est perpetuò illustris & generosus GVBERNATOR Dn. GVILHELMVS LVDOVICVS Comes Nassovius, &c.
Bernh. Coenders. | Ioes Tiard à Starkeb.

page.notes: The headpiece at the top is an ornament, not transcribed. Long s in "istorum" is read as a plain s; the scan shows "iflorum". The small capitals in "GVBERNATOR" and "GVILHELMVS LVDOVICVS" are set as capitals. The year 1595 stands in a bracket beside the list and is given as its own line. "Bocco" and "Dodo" are followed by an abbreviated form that is uncertain ("a" with [?]). "Ioes Tiard à Starkeb." is set as printed, with the final letters doubtful. The signature "A 5" is uncertain. The catchword "Iidem" is as printed.
